notes: #3, #4 and #13 are Rijeka Crnojevića in Montenegro, not this city. #7 dates to 1897–99 per the record (the Adria Palace was new then); #5, the Corso with the City Tower, is a strong alternative for P4. #8 is an 1883 port map. Bain’s 1915 date for #9 is the record’s date for the negative.
